sources.snippet: Abstract This paper provides an overview of artificial-intelligence (AI), as applied to dermatology. We focus our discussion on methodology, AI applications for various skin diseases, limitations, and future opportunities. We review how the current image-based models are being implemented in dermatology across disease subsets, and highlight the challenges facing widespread adoption ...

sources.snippet: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in dermatology is skyrocketing, but a comprehensive overview integrating regulatory, ethical, validation, and clinical issues is lacking.
